All Purpose Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): A general seasoning blend of salt, pepper, garlic and onion. Savoury and mild — made to go on anything rather than to taste of one thing.
Asin Tibuok Dinosaur Egg Salt 500g (Natu: Bohol's own asin tibuok, salt hardened inside a clay pot over burning coconut husk. Smoky and rounded, far more complex than plain salt — it is cracked, not poured.
Atsuete Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground annatto seed, used across Filipino cooking for its deep orange-red colour. Barely any flavour of its own — faintly peppery and nutty at most.
Banana Blossom 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Dried banana blossom. Mild and a little bitter, with a soft, fibrous texture once it has soaked.
Barbeque Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): A sweet, smoky barbecue seasoning blend. Paprika and sugar lead, with garlic and a touch of heat behind them.
Basil Flakes 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Dried basil leaf. Sweet and faintly aniseed, gentler and hayier than the fresh herb.
Bay Leaves 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Whole dried bay leaves. Woody and slightly bitter — a background note rather than a flavour you taste directly.
Beef Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Powdered beef stock. Deeply savoury and salty, for putting a meaty base under a dish.
Beef Stew Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A blend from Muscat Blends built for beef stew. Savoury and herb-led, with pepper, onion and bay sitting behind it.
Black Pepper Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground black pepper. Sharp and woody, with a slow heat that builds at the back of the mouth.
Buttermilk 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Powdered buttermilk. Tangy and faintly sweet, carrying the sourness fresh buttermilk has.
Cajun Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): A Cajun-style blend of paprika, cayenne, garlic, onion and herbs. Warm and smoky, with a real and steady heat.
Cardamon Brown 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Brown cardamom pods. Strongly smoky and resinous — much heavier and more savoury than the green kind.
Cayenne Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground cayenne chilli. Plainly hot, with little flavour of its own beyond a dry fruitiness.
Celery Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground dried celery. Savoury and slightly bitter, with the green, salty note celery gives.
Cheese Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Powdered cheese. Sharp, salty and tangy — the strongest flavoured of the dairy powders here.
Chia Seeds 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Whole chia seeds. Almost no flavour; dry they add a faint nutty crunch, and in liquid they swell into a soft gel.
Chicken Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Powdered chicken stock. Savoury and salty, lighter and milder than the beef powder.
Chili Flakes 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Crushed dried chilli, seeds and all. Hot and faintly smoky, the flakes giving uneven bursts of heat.
Chili Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground dried chilli. Hot and even all through, deeper and earthier than the flakes.
Cinnamon Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground cinnamon. Sweet and warm, with a faint woody bitterness underneath.
Cinnamon Stick Slim 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Thin rolled quills of cinnamon bark. The same sweet warmth as the powder, but slower and cleaner when it steeps in liquid.
Cloves Whole 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Whole dried clove buds. Intensely sweet, warm and almost medicinal — a very little goes a long way.
Coffee Steak Rub 100g (Muscat Blends): A steak rub from Muscat Blends built on ground coffee. Dark and bitter-sweet, with salt and pepper behind it.
Coriander Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground coriander seed. Warm, citrusy and mildly sweet — nothing like the fresh leaf.
Coriander Seeds 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Whole coriander seed. Lemony and warm, brighter and more fragrant than the ground powder.
Cornstarch 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Plain cornflour. Tasteless on its own; it thickens liquid and gives a light, dry coating.
Cumin Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground cumin seed. Warm, earthy and slightly bitter, with a smoky depth that carries a long way.
Curry Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): A mild yellow curry blend, turmeric-led. Warm and earthy rather than hot, with coriander and cumin behind the colour.
Fine Grain Sea Salt 600g Iodized (Member: Fine iodised sea salt, 600g. Clean and plainly salty, ground fine enough to dissolve straight away.
Fish Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A blend from Muscat Blends for fish. Bright and herbal, with lemon, dill and pepper notes through it.
Five Spice 50g (Chef's Cabinet): The Chinese five-spice blend — star anise, clove, cinnamon, fennel and pepper. Sweet, warm and liquorice-like, strong even in small amounts.
Fried Garlic 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Garlic sliced and fried crisp. Sweet, nutty and toasty, without the bite raw garlic has.
Garlic Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground dried garlic. Savoury and sweet, rounder and far less sharp than fresh garlic.
Ginger Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground dried ginger. Hot and peppery with a dry, woody sweetness — sharper than fresh ginger and not as juicy.
Grilled Chicken Rub 100g (Muscat Blends): A rub from Muscat Blends for chicken. Savoury and lightly smoky, with paprika, garlic and herbs.
Himalayan Pink Salt Fine Grind 250g (Gre: Finely ground pink rock salt from Greenola, 250g. Clean and faintly mineral, a touch softer in taste than sea salt.
Himalayan Salt 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Pink rock salt in a 50g pouch. Clean and faintly mineral, with the pale colour the rock itself gives.
Italian Herbs 50g (Chef's Cabinet): A dried blend of oregano, basil, thyme and marjoram. Green and savoury — the standard herb note of Italian cooking.
Korean Chili Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Gochugaru, Korean chilli ground coarse. Fruity and faintly smoky with a bright, moderate heat — far milder than cayenne.
Meat Tenderizer 50g (Chef's Cabinet): A powder that softens the fibres in tougher cuts of meat. Lightly salty, with little flavour of its own.
Mustard Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground mustard seed. Dry and dusty in the packet, sharply hot and pungent the moment it meets liquid.
Nutmeg Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground nutmeg. Sweet, warm and slightly resinous, with a faint bitterness at the finish.
Onion Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground dried onion. Sweet and savoury, with the depth of cooked onion rather than the bite of raw.
Oregano Flakes 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Dried oregano leaf. Strongly herbal and faintly bitter, peppery and more pungent than basil.
Oregano Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground oregano. The same herbal, peppery bitterness as the flakes, but it spreads evenly instead of sitting on top.
Pangasinan Organic Rock Salt 500g (The S: Coarse rock salt from Pangasinan under our own label, 500g. Clean and strongly salty, with crystals big enough to crunch.
Parsley Flakes 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Dried parsley leaf. Mild and grassy — there more for colour and freshness than for strong flavour.
Parsley Garlic Salt 110g (Organic Season: Salt blended with parsley and garlic, 110g. Savoury and green, salty first with the garlic arriving after.
Peri-Peri Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A peri-peri blend from Muscat Blends, built on African bird's eye chilli. Hot and tangy, with lemon and garlic cutting through the heat.
Pork Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Powdered pork stock. Savoury and salty, with a rounder and sweeter depth than the beef or chicken powders.
Pork Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A blend from Muscat Blends for pork. Savoury and lightly sweet, with sage, pepper and garlic running through it.
Rock Salt 50g: Coarse rock salt in a 50g pouch. Plainly salty, with big crystals that stay crunchy.
Rosemary Flakes 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Dried rosemary leaf. Piney and resinous — one of the strongest herbs here, woody rather than green.
Saffron Kasubha 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Kasubha, the dried safflower sold throughout the Philippines in place of saffron. It gives the same golden colour, with only a faint earthy flavour of its own.
Salmon Rub & Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blen: A rub from Muscat Blends for salmon. Herbal and bright, with dill, lemon and pepper leading.
Salted Egg Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Powdered salted duck egg. Very salty and rich, with the deep savoury flavour of the cured yolk.
Sesame Seeds Black 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Whole black sesame seeds. Nuttier and a little more bitter than the white ones, with a stronger, darker flavour.
Sesame Seeds White 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Whole white sesame seeds. Mild, sweet and nutty, and nuttier still once toasted.
Skimmed Milk 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Skimmed milk powder. Mildly sweet and milky, with none of the richness of the full-fat kind.
Smoked Paprika Brown 50g (Chef's Cabinet: Paprika dried over smoke. Deeply smoky and sweet, with no heat at all — the smoke is the whole point.
Sour Cream 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Powdered sour cream. Tangy and creamy — the flavour of sour cream without the moisture.
Spanish Paprika Red 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Sweet Spanish paprika. Bright red, sweet and mild, with a gentle earthiness and no heat.
Star Anise 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Whole star anise pods. Strongly liquorice-sweet and warm — one pod flavours a whole pot.
Steak Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A steak blend from Muscat Blends. Coarse, peppery and salty, with garlic and onion through it.
Texas BBQ Blend 100g (Muscat Blends): A Texas-style barbecue blend from Muscat Blends. Heavy on black pepper and paprika — savoury and smoky rather than sweet.
Thyme Flakes 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Dried thyme leaf. Earthy and slightly minty, quieter than rosemary and easier to use a lot of.
Turkey Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A blend from Muscat Blends for turkey. Herbal and warming, with sage, thyme and pepper leading.
Turmeric Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground turmeric root. Earthy and slightly bitter, with a strong golden-yellow colour that stains whatever it touches.
White Pepper Powder 50g (Chef's Cabinet): Ground white pepper. Hotter and more pungent than black pepper, musty and earthy instead of woody.
